text: Implemented typed dataset metadata/events. Added DatasetFieldId and ConditionLabel opaque ids, DatasetValue ADT with source-preserving parsed values, DatasetEventRow typed accessors for onset/duration/run/session/condition, DatasetEvents rectangular validation and run-axis validation, and FmriDataset event/timeAxis alignment checks. Updated FmriModelBuilder to consume DatasetEvents typed columns rather than raw Map[String,String] rows; kept DatasetEvents(Vector[Map[String,String]]) as compatibility ingestion. Tests: live workspace sbt datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test passed; live model tests are blocked by the separately reserved dirty design issue bd-01KWY6K7PJHCYN9K91B4S06347. Clean HEAD overlay with only modules/dataset and modules/model changes passed sbt datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test modelJVM/test modelJS/test.
